text:
Predicates:
GivenOut(x, y) ::: x is given out on TV at time y.
Bachelor(x) ::: x is on the Bachelor.
Portrays(x, y) ::: x portrays the lives of y.
RealityTVShow(x) ::: x is a reality TV show.
Premises:
∃x GivenOut(roses, Monday8pm) ::: On some Mondays at 8 pm, roses are given out on TV.
∀x (GivenOut(x, TV) → Bachelor(x)) ::: Every rose given out on TV is on the Bachelor.
∀x (Bachelor(x) → Portrays(x, realPeople)) ::: Everything on the Bachelor portrays the lives of real people.
∀x (Portrays(x, realPeople) → RealityTVShow(x)) ::: All shows portraying the lives of real people are reality TV shows.
¬RealityTVShow(breakingBad) ::: Breaking Bad is not a reality TV show.
Conclusion:
GivenOut(roses, breakingBad) → GivenOut(roses, Monday8pm) ::: If roses are given out during Breaking Bad, then it is on Monday at 8 pm.
